title: Military aircraft to fly over KU campus Thursday, Friday in advance of football game
summary_en: Military jets will fly over the University of Kansas campus Thursday, Sept. 3, and Friday, Sept. 4, in advance of Friday’s football game between KU and Long Island University.
title_cn: Military aircraft to fly over KU campus Thursday, Friday in advance of football game

title: KU alumna, NASA astronaut Loral O’Hara to headline KU Reads event Oct. 8
summary_en: The University of Kansas will welcome home one of its own this fall when KU alumna and NASA astronaut Loral O'Hara returns to Lawrence for a public event celebrating the 2026-27 KU Reads: A Common Book Experience selection.
title_cn: KU alumna, NASA astronaut Loral O’Hara to headline KU Reads event Oct. 8

title: KU law professor traces legal history of the kiss
summary_en: Andrew Torrance, a professor of law at the University of Kansas, has published research on how kissing, one of the most basic human acts and a sign of love, has been viewed alternately as property that can be stolen, a contract, a criminal act or as agency over one’s own body. His article was published in the journal Evolution and Human Behavior.
title_cn: KU law professor traces legal history of the kiss

title: University Honors Program announces five additions to Honors Faculty Fellow cohort
summary_en: The University Honors Program has welcomed five KU faculty members to its cohort of Honors Faculty Fellows, who join six continuing fellows as well as one returning fellow for the fall 2026 semester.
title_cn: University Honors Program announces five additions to Honors Faculty Fellow cohort
